image_description: A man in a black t-shirt and cap is holding a large sturgeon fish in shallow water next to a white motorboat. Another man is standing on the boat in the background. The scene is set on a lake or river with forested hills in the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sturgeon's head is clearly elongated and the mouth is positioned on the ventral (underside) surface, consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Four distinct barbels are visible hanging down in front of the mouth area.
The snout is clearly pointed and elongated, typical of sturgeon.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish has a long, torpedo-shaped (fusiform) body that appears very large relative to the man holding it.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of bony plates (scutes) are visible along the lateral line and dorsal area of the fish's body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal side is grayish-brown while the ventral side (belly) is noticeably lighter/whitish.
The tail fin is clearly asymmetrical with the upper lobe being longer than the lower lobe, characteristic of a heterocercal tail.
